therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: inhibition of protein-protein interactions of EWS-FLI1 fusion protein
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed or refractory Ewing sarcoma

subgroup_findings: responses only observed in expansion cohort (3/44 patients)
results.dose_information: dose escalation from 18 mg/m² to 288 mg/m² over 7-28 day cycles, expansion cohort and 175 mg/m² cohort included
